headline: Frontlines Shift as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map’s most volatile corridors have deepened their exchange. Nevish Line still records fifty ownership changes in the past day, though both sides’ casualty rates have cooled to roughly 144 and 210 per hour. Palantine Berm has slipped to forty‑five flips; Colonial losses are now accelerating at twenty‑one per hour while Warden losses hold steady, and enlistments are cooling. Callahans Passage remains a meat‑grinder with twenty‑three flips, each side suffering near five hundred casualties an hour and both trends accelerating despite a dip in fresh enlistments. Weathered Expanse adds twenty‑six exchanges; Colonial casualties are rising again at three hundred ninety‑nine per hour and Warden losses at six hundred seven, with enlistments also climbing. Mooring County has surged to six flips, three in the last two hours, and both casualty streams are accelerating to about five hundred fifty per hour. Kuura Strand’s activity has eased to eleven flips after a brief spike; casualty rates are flat but enlistments are beginning to accelerate. The remaining regions stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition reported.
